question:
**Direction: Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Assail
solution: The correct answer is **"Attack."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Assail"** means to attack violently or criticize harshly. ((शारीरिक या शाब्दिक रूप से) तीव्र प्रहार करना) • **Example**: *The army was able to **assail**__ the enemy's stronghold and capture it.* • The word **'attack'** means to try to hurt or defeat somebody/something by using force. (हमला या आक्रमण करना) __ • **Example**: *The child was **attacked**__ by a dog.* • So,** "attack"** is the word that means the same as the given word **"assail."** • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Perform)** means to carry out a task or action. (कोई काम आदि करना जिसके लिए आदेश है) • **Option 2 (Systematic)** means following a systematic or organized approach. (निश्चित योजना या विधि से किया गया; सुव्‍यवस्थित, योजनानुसार) • **Option 4 (Shield)** means to protect or defend someone or something. (संकट या हानि से किसी को बचाना) 1de:T572, The correct answer is **"sun to dry."**
